policy.method: public web/search metadata and public pages only
policy.engagementRule: Only directly visible/verifiable engagement is canonical; secondary or absent values remain non-canonical/null.

candidates.title: Yen rally faces a BOJ test after its sharpest rise in 18 months
candidates.whyItMayWork: Currency moves plus a near-term central-bank decision make a compact before/after explainer card.
candidates.whyItMayBeWeak: Fast-moving market context must be timestamped and must not become investment advice.

candidates.title: Anthropic launches Claude tooling aimed at financial advisers
candidates.whyItMayWork: AI moving into a specific professional workflow gives a concrete jobs-and-tools angle rather than generic AI hype.
candidates.whyItMayBeWeak: Product capability claims need attribution and should not imply verified investment performance.

candidates.title: Players debate a crowded September release calendar as publishers avoid GTA 6
candidates.whyItMayWork: The release-calendar pileup is timely in September and the visible discussion gives a community-first angle.
candidates.whyItMayBeWeak: The 170 figure is a visible comment score, not total post engagement; it must not be relabeled as post votes.

candidates.title: Parent asks how to restart a psychology career after years of full-time caregiving
candidates.whyItMayWork: A relatable return-to-work question can support a respectful career discussion without sensational framing.
candidates.whyItMayBeWeak: Popularity signal is weak and the story involves a private person and family medical context, so direct republishing or identifying detail reuse should be avoided.
